morphology.pattern_note: 英语姓氏在马来文中作为完整专名使用；末尾 -er 不是此处可拆出的马来语词缀。常规书写为 Lassiter；IPA 为常见英语读法参考，具体读法须尊重本人。

senses.zh_definition: 拉西特：英语姓氏，源于地名姓传统；具体人物由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Lassiter, an English habitational surname associated with Leicester.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang berasal daripada nama tempat Leicester; individu yang dimaksudkan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，pos 因给定标签范围而记为 noun。输入未提供具体人物或作品，不能直接指定为某位运动员、演员或虚构角色。常规写法为 Lassiter，输入键及 headword.word 保留原始小写。未核实为 DBP 马来语词条，马来文释义为编写释义；搭配为自然姓名用法，未作语料频率认证。来源参见 [Dictionary of American Family Names，经 FamilySearch 转载](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=lassiter)。

etymology.historical_story: Lassiter illustrates how a place of origin can become a family name. The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies it as a habitational surname from Leicester and notes its long establishment in North America. Its modern spelling should therefore be learned as an inherited name, rather than divided into familiar-looking English or Malay fragments that do not explain its history. See [FamilySearch's surname reference](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=lassiter).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把常见读音近似记成“拉西特”，再与具体人物的脸或姓名牌配对；不要把结尾 -er 当成马来语构词线索。
